summary: Iteration 6 frontend retest of the two fixes from iteration_5. Both now work. (1) Stale guest flag: with aoc_guest='1' in localStorage and no aoc_guest cookie, /dashboard redirects to / in about 1s. The landing page shows, there is no 'Couldn't load your profile', and the flag is cleared. (2) Live mode as the founder (Clerk ticket): POST /api/advisor/competitors/find returns 424, and the toast says 'Finding competitors failed. EXA_API_KEY is not set'. GET google/status returns 424, and the page shows the app's message 'Checking Google connection failed. COMPOSIO_API_KEY is not set'. Guest regression passes: landing-try-button goes to /dashboard with guest-bar, and #1 is 'Reply to Sam at Beta Corp...'. The founder was restored to manual mode: the mode-manual card is active and the toast says 'Back to your typed list'.
critical_code_review_comments: Guards.jsx now captures guest once via useState and clears the flag in useEffect, so it is StrictMode-safe. useMe no longer retries on 401.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md; founder via python tests/clerk_token.py founder ticket
seed_data_creation: One guest session was created. Founder was set to live, then restored to manual.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stale flag repro: on /, set localStorage aoc_guest='1', go to /dashboard and poll the URL. Live checks are on /connections after clicking mode-live; restore with mode-manual.
